translations.de: Ich habe mir in den Daumen geschnitten.
translations.vi: Tôi đã cắt vào ngón tay cái của mình.
translations.ja: 親指を切ってしまいました。

tokens.explanation: Personal subject clitic pronoun, 1st person singular; syntactic subject of the clause.
Reflexive clitic pronoun (1st sg) marking a pronominal construction (se couper); here functions as an indirect object indicating the affected possessor.
Auxiliary ‘être’, present indicative (1st sg), forming the passé composé of the pronominal verb.
Past participle of the lexical verb; head of the compound predicate in passé composé. In pronominal use, agreement is with a preceding direct object (none here), so default masculine singular form.
Definite article, masculine singular, introducing the body-part noun; definite article is used with pronominal body-part constructions instead of a possessive.
Common noun, masculine; direct object of the verb (what was cut).

sentences.target: On lève le pouce pour faire du stop.
sentences.reading: /ɔ̃ lɛv lə pus puʁ fɛʁ dy stɔp/

translations.ipa: /ɔ̃ lɛv lə pus puʁ fɛʁ dy stɔp/
translations.en: We stick out our thumb to hitchhike.
translations.es: Sacamos el pulgar para hacer autostop.
translations.de: Wir strecken den Daumen raus, um per Anhalter zu fahren.

translations.zh-Hans: 我们招手搭车时会竖起大拇指。

translations.vi: Chúng tôi giơ ngón tay cái để quá giang.
translations.nl: We steken onze duim op om te liften.
translations.uk: Ми виставляємо великий палець, щоб голосувати.
translations.hi: हम लिफ्ट लेने के लिए अंगूठा दिखाते हैं।

translations.nb: Vi stikker tommelen ut for å haike.

translations.da: Vi stikker tommelfingeren ud for at blaffe.
translations.ja: ヒッチハイクするときは親指を立てます。

translations.id: Kamu membuka kunci dengan ibu jarimu.

sentences.target: Le bébé suce son pouce pour dormir.
sentences.reading: /lə bebe sys sɔ̃ pus puʁ dɔʁmiʁ/

translations.fr: Le bébé suce son pouce pour dormir.
translations.ipa: /lə bebe sys sɔ̃ pus puʁ dɔʁmiʁ/
translations.en: The baby sucks their thumb to sleep.
translations.es: El bebé se chupa el pulgar para dormir.
translations.de: Das Baby lutscht am Daumen, um einzuschlafen.
translations.it: Il bambino succhia il pollice per dormire.
translations.zh-Hans: 宝宝会吸吮拇指来睡觉。
translations.ru: Ребёнок сосёт большой палец, чтобы заснуть.
translations.pt: O bebé chupa o polegar para dormir.
translations.he: התינוק מוצץ את האגודל שלו כדי להירדם.
translations.vi: Em bé mút ngón tay cái để ngủ.
translations.nl: De baby zuigt op zijn duim om in slaap te vallen.
translations.uk: Дитина смокче великий палець, щоб заснути.
translations.hu: A baba az ujját szopja, hogy elaludjon.
translations.hi: बच्चा सोने के लिए अपना अंगूठा चूसता है।
translations.el: Το μωρό πιπιλάει τον αντίχειρά του για να κοιμηθεί.
translations.nb: Babyen suger på tommelen for å sovne.
translations.id: Bayi itu mengisap jempolnya untuk tidur.
translations.sv: Bebisen suger på tummen för att somna.
translations.ro: Bebelușul își suge degetul mare ca să adoarmă.
translations.cs: Dítě si cucá palec, aby usnulo.
translations.da: Babyen sutter på sin tommelfinger for at sove.
translations.ja: 赤ちゃんは眠るために親指をしゃぶります。
